shortDescription: implements rest api for snmp trap configuration

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: arp_protect
options.description: Traps for dynamic arp protection

options.name: aut_server_fail
options.description: Traps reporting authentication server unreachable

options.name: dhcp_server
options.description: Traps for dhcp server

options.name: dhcp_snooping
options.description: Traps for dhcp snooping

options.name: dhcpv6_snooping_errant_replies
options.description: Traps for DHCPv6 snooping errant replies

options.name: dhcpv6_snooping_out_of_resource
options.description: Enable traps for dhcpv6 snooping out of resource

options.name: dyn_ip_lockdown
options.description: Traps for Dynamic Ip Lockdown

options.name: dyn_ipv6_ld_out_of_resources
options.displayName: Dyn Ipv6 Ld Out Of Resources
options.description: Enable traps for Dynamic IPv6 Lockdown out of resources

options.name: dyn_ipv6_ld_violations
options.description: Enable traps for Dynamic IPv6 Lockdown violations.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: login_failure_mgr
options.description: Traps for management interface login failure

options.name: mac_count_notify
options.description: Traps for MAC addresses learned on the specified ports exceeds the threshold

options.name: mac_move_notify_mode
options.description: Traps for move mac address table changes

options.name: mac_notify_mode
options.description: Traps for mac notify

options.name: mac_notify_trap_interval
options.description: Trap interval for mac_move_notify_mode and mac_notify_mode

options.name: macsec_failure
options.description: Enable the MACsec Connectivity Association (CA) failure trap

options.name: nd_snooping_out_of_resources
options.description: The trap for nd snooping out of resources

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: password_change_mgr
options.description: Traps for management interface password change

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: port_security
options.description: Traps for port access authentication failure

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: running_conf_change_trap
options.description: Traps mode for running config change

options.name: running_config_trap_interval
options.description: Traps interval for running_conf_change_trap

options.name: snmp_authentication
options.description: Select RFC1157 (standard) or HP-ICF-SNMP (extended) traps

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: startup_config_change
options.description: Traps for changed to the startup config

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.
